result.description:
Placed.au is looking for a full-time Waitress for our client in Alice Springs, Northern Territory.

Job Description

•	Provide friendly, professional, and efficient table service to all customers, ensuring a high standard of customer care at all times.

•	Welcome and seat customers, present menus, explain menu items, and answer questions regarding food, beverages, and daily specials.

•	Take accurate food and beverage orders using the café's ordering system and communicate orders promptly to the kitchen and barista.

•	Serve food and beverages in a timely and professional manner, ensuring orders are complete and presented to the café's quality standards.

•	Monitor customer satisfaction throughout service and promptly respond to requests or concerns, referring any significant issues to management where required.

•	Clear and reset tables efficiently to maintain a clean, organised, and welcoming dining environment.

•	Prepare and maintain dining areas before, during, and after service, ensuring tables, service stations, and customer areas remain clean and well presented.

•	Assist with opening and closing procedures, including setting up service areas, restocking supplies, and cleaning equipment and 
workstations.

•	Process customer payments accurately using the point-of-sale (POS) system and follow cash handling procedures in accordance with café policies.

•	Maintain adequate stock levels of service items, condiments, takeaway packaging, and beverages, notifying management when replenishment is required.

•	Follow all food safety, hygiene, and workplace health and safety procedures to ensure compliance with relevant legislation and café standards.

•	Work collaboratively with kitchen and front-of-house staff to ensure efficient service and a positive customer experience during busy 
service periods.

•	Maintain a professional appearance, positive attitude, and courteous manner at all times while representing the business.

Qualifications / Attributes

•	Must hold a Certificate II in Hospitality or a related qualification, or at least one (1) year of relevant work experience may substitute for the formal qualification

•	Must possess at least one (1) year of relevant work experience as a Waitress, Waiter, Food and Beverage Attendant, or in a similar hospitality role

•	Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills with the ability to build positive relationships with customers

•	Strong communication skills with the ability to confidently explain menu items and take accurate orders

•	Experience operating point-of-sale (POS) systems and handling cash and EFTPOS transactions accurately

•	Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced café or hospitality environment while maintaining a high standard of service

•	Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise tasks during busy service periods

•	High attention to detail to ensure accurate order taking, food presentation, and customer satisfaction

•	A genuine passion for hospitality and delivering exceptional customer experiences

Salary

$70,000 – $85,000 per annum excluding superannuation.
